crossRefs.note: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
I will also spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the…
David says, “Let their table be made a snare, a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.

translations.web: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.
translations.bsb: A noose is hidden in the ground, and a trap lies in his path.
translations.kjv: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.
translations.asv: A noose is hid for him in the ground, And a trap for him in the way.
